name: Dimitrios Papas
bio:
Dimitrios Papas has been a fixture in motorsport operations for over three decades. Starting as a junior mechanic in rally racing, his meticulous nature and problem-solving skills quickly propelled him through the ranks. He transitioned to team management, honing his ability to orchestrate complex logistical challenges and technical requirements.

Throughout his career, Dimitrios has earned a reputation for his pragmatic approach and unwavering commitment to efficiency. He believes in empowering his team members while maintaining strict standards for quality and performance. His experience spans various motorsport disciplines, but he now feels he has found a home in Indycar.

His dedication to precision and process optimization makes him a valuable asset. He is known to be extremely particular about preparation and organization. He is driven by a desire to see every aspect of the team operating at peak efficiency, and he is known for his ability to quickly identify and address bottlenecks.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: A stocky man with a commanding presence, Dimitrios carries himself with an air of quiet authority.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down observations.
Insists on reviewing all checklists before every race.
Drinks a cup of strong Greek coffee at precisely 10:00 AM every day.
